title: BTS Arrive in Santiago for Three-Night Estadio Nacional Run
detail: BTS reached Santiago on the night of Oct 11 after closing their Lima run, ahead of ARIRANG World Tour shows on Oct 14, 16 and 17 at Estadio Nacional — their first Chile performances in almost nine years. Chile's sports institute (IND) had approved the venue on July 21 after an initial refusal over pitch damage, once the promoter agreed to technical changes. Coverage of the shows themselves was not yet available at update time.

media.caption: BTS already in Chile; J-Hope and Jimin share first postcards
